LC_100.market_premium: High collector trust; German-delivered papers retain +3% to +5% premium.

LC_010.market_premium: Home country origin; highly prized by European collectors.

LC_888.market_premium: Huge volume market; verification of original dealer stamp essential.

LC_028.market_premium: Birthplace of vintage Rolex collecting; Italian papers highly liquid.

LC_400.market_premium: Rhodium / Uğur Saat official AD warranty papers.

LC_527.market_premium: Ahmed Seddiqi & Sons; sought-after Arabic calendar Day-Date variants.

126610lv_submariner.key_verification: MK1 (2020-2023) has darker hunter-green bezel; MK2 (late 2023+) has lighter lime-green hue matching original 16610LV.

116610lv_submariner.key_verification: Sunburst metallic green dial (aluminum PVD) paired with green Cerachrom bezel. Discontinued in 2020.

126710blro_gmt.key_verification: MK1 bezel (2018-2019) has pastel violet/pink under UV light; MK2/MK3 bezels have deep cobalt blue and ruby red.

126710blnr_gmt.key_verification: Transition line between blue and black at 18:00 and 06:00 is seamless without color bleed.

126720vtnr_gmt.key_verification: Crown and date aperture located at 9 o'clock. Requires unique upside-down dial and date wheel alignment.

126711chnr_gmt.key_verification: Two-tone 18k Everose gold and 904L steel with brown/black ceramic bezel.

126613lb_submariner.key_verification: Royal blue sunburst dial with gold-filled ceramic bezel lettering.

116619lb_submariner.key_verification: Solid 18k white gold case with flat non-sunburst lacquered pastel blue dial. Heavy weight (~230 grams).

226570_explorer2.key_verification: Phantom hands effect created by black PVD base on white lacquered dial.

116500ln_daytona.key_verification: Asymmetrical subdial layout (3 and 9 o'clock subdials slightly elevated above horizontal centerline on in-house Calibre 4130/4131).

collector_notes: Dark rhodium/slate dial with green-bordered black Roman numerals (Tribute to tennis grass courts at Wimbledon). 9 o'clock marker is a single luminescent baton for dial orientation.
